pages.text: A base trades its $(l)minerals$() for its race's $(l)armor$(): armor shards (suits, resource crates) and armor blocks — walls, doors, slabs, stairs, ramparts, portholes, bars. Open it with $(l)Exchange (O)$() under the selected storage building in the command view, or with an empty hand: $(l)sneak and right-click$() a storage building of yours. A click buys one, a shift-click eight; the price is paid from the base's minerals.
